fact: Zimbabwe's Civil Registry Department says it has introduced automated validation and synchronization with the National Population Register, and a pilot of CRVS-Health interoperability in 3 provinces is planned for Q1-Q2 2027.
Zimbabwe's Civil Registry Department registers births and deaths and issues national identity documents, so one body holds both functions, per the home affairs minister.
The Civil Registry Department issues birth and death certificates and national identity cards and is custodian of the national citizens' database, so one body holds both.
